name: Dual Invention
body:
Prerequisite(s): Tinkerer Class, Dexterity 15 or higher, character level 6th or higher

Benefit(s): Once per day, as a full-round action, you can activate two different inventions that each normally require a standard action to activate. Both inventions must have been assembled during your daily preparation.
